newsitem.title: LATVIA: LITHUANIA-VILNIAUS BANK, ABN AMRO COMPLETE PROGRAMME.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-VILNIAUS BANK, ABN AMRO COMPLETE PROGRAMME.

text.p: Lithuania's leading private commerical bank Vilniaus Bank said on Friday that it had successfully completed its two-year twinning programme with ABN AMRO Bank of the Netherlands.

The bank said in a statement that the programme's goals, including the introduction of modern banking technologies, the formation of a favourable international image, and the strengthening of its position in local financial markets, were achieved.
International banking standards were introduced under the programme, a comprehensive bank manual was prepared, and a modern lending and loan administration system was developed, the statement said.
The programme was carried out under the auspices of EU PHARE and was supported by the World Bank.
